entities.description: The Ace of Batons in the Tarot de Marseille. A single large club or branch, alive and leafing. Represents the pure creative force of fire, new enterprise, and the seed of ambition.

extendedData.meaning: the pure creative force of fire, new enterprise, and the seed of ambition
